PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission for this
VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this while you were editing
LAST_ADMIN: The system must always keep one active admin
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts — try again later
IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request was already sent with different data
INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side
NETWORK: No connection — your work is kept
field.invalid_username: Use letters, digits, dot or underscore only
field.phone_taken: This phone number is already used
field.password_is_username: The password cannot be the username
field.passwords_do_not_match: The two passwords do not match
field.future_date: The date cannot be in the future
EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: This order can no longer be edited — void it and enter it again
STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Stock for {{item}} is {{available}} and you are selling {{requested}}
RECEIVED_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE: That is more than a rate difference — record a discount or a credit instead
REBASE_RATE_REQUIRED: Agree a rate with the customer before changing the currency
price_required: This material has no price yet — type one
customer_no_side: Choose at least one: customer or company
customer_side_in_use: This side already has records, so it cannot be turned off
not_a_customer: We only buy from this company — mark it as a customer too before selling to it
walk_in_cash_only: The walk-in customer takes cash orders only
record_referenced: This record is used elsewhere, so it can only be deactivated
note_required_balance: This customer still has a balance — write a note
payment_exceeds_remaining: That is more than the remaining {{remaining}}
discount_too_large: The discount cannot be larger than the total
duplicate_company: A company with this name already exists
company_inactive: That company is hidden — show it again before recording a purchase
order_customer_immutable: An order cannot be moved to another customer — void it and enter it again
purchase_company_immutable: A purchase cannot be moved to another company — void it and enter it again
note_required_adjustment: Say why the balance is being changed (at least three characters)
adjustment_unchanged: That is the balance already — nothing to change
stock_insufficient: There is not enough stock of {{item}}: {{available}} left, {{requested}} asked for
credit_needs_company: A credit belongs to the company the goods came from; this record names none
return_not_allowed: This record is "{{from}}" and cannot be marked "{{action}}"
return_to_stock_customer_only: Only goods a customer brought back can be put into stock again
already_returned_to_stock: These goods have already been put back into stock
no_settlement: This order has no cash settlement to reverse
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large — split it into two smaller ones.
